name: gallery-core
title: Gallery
description: Gallery workflow filters, and actions for shared spaces
author: Gallery

methods.name: assetTagPathFilter
methods.title: Filter by tag, with its sub-tags
methods.description: Continue for assets that have the tag or a tag under it, e.g. Food matches Food/Noma/Tartare

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: The tag, e.g. Food or Food/Noma (not case-sensitive)

inverse.title: Inverse
inverse.description: Continue for assets without the tag and without any tag under it instead

methods.name: addToSpace
methods.title: Add to space
methods.description: Add the asset to one or more shared spaces

methods.name: addToSpaceAlbum
methods.title: Add to space album
methods.description: Add the asset to an album in a shared space, creating it if needed

spaceId.title: Space
spaceId.description: The shared space that owns the album

albumName.title: Album name
albumName.description: Uses this album if it exists in the space, otherwise creates and links it
